newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Associated Kaolin plans bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Associated Kaolin plans bonus issue.

text.p: Malaysia's Associated Kaolin Industries Bhd has proposed a one-for-one bonus issue of up to 42.62 million new shares, to be capitalised from the company's share premium account.

A statement from the company's bankers said the bonus issue was based on the enlarged share capital of Associated Kaolin after the proposed special issue of 3.47 million new shares to bumiputera (ethnic Malay) shareholders and assuming full exercise of 13.05 million Associated Kaolin warrants.
Associated Kaolin's paid-up capital will increase to 85.24 million shares after the bonus issue.
